applies_when: PT stuck person has a prepared PT trip with at least one deterministic audit reason
proven_interpretation: The stuck is linked to the first sorted proven itinerary reason
policy_boundary: Does not infer fare capacity demand or supply policy

applies_when: walk-family stuck person has a prepared PT trip with at least one deterministic audit reason
proven_interpretation: The stuck is linked to the first sorted proven PT/walk itinerary reason
policy_boundary: Unresolved fields remain unresolved and are never numeric zero

applies_when: PT stuck person has a legal prepared itinerary
proven_interpretation: Prepared itinerary legality did not explain the runtime stuck
policy_boundary: Requires later authorized event/run evidence before any capacity supply or policy conclusion

applies_when: walk-family stuck person has a legal prepared PT itinerary
proven_interpretation: Prepared PT/walk itinerary legality did not explain the runtime stuck

applies_when: PT stuck event has no matching audited PT-trip profile
proven_interpretation: The event and prepared-plan audit cannot be reconciled
policy_boundary: No synthetic trip or numeric fallback is created

applies_when: walk-family stuck person has no audited PT trip
proven_interpretation: The stuck is not attributed to the PT itinerary layer
policy_boundary: Remains available to another authorized diagnostic scope

applies_when: stuck mode is neither PT nor a recognized walk-family mode
proven_interpretation: The event is outside Stage 6 PT/walk attribution
